title: build new in a project with no jitso/jitso.yaml and no repo builds first writes the jitso/jitso.yaml skeleton (empty allowlists), then the draft; a second call finds the skeleton and writes only the draft
source: intended: docs/decisions.md D7 and the templates row of the other decisions (a new build starts as a draft from a template: invalid until every empty value is filled)
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-14, shipped core and templates; docs/decisions.md D7). In a fresh project (no `jitso/jitso.yaml` and no `*.yaml` in `jitso/builds/`) `jitso build new <id>` first writes the commented `jitso/jitso.yaml` skeleton with empty allowlists, printing `wrote jitso/jitso.yaml (empty allowlists: fill them first)`, then the draft. It never overwrites the skeleton and does not create `jitso/builds/`. A second call finds `jitso/jitso.yaml` and writes only the draft line. The oracle has no `build new` (the runner maps only `build list`): it answers `unknown command` on stderr with exit 2, so every expectation that needs the written file or the printed line FAILS on it.

wrote jitso/jitso.yaml (empty allowlists: fill them first)
wrote .jitso/drafts/first-one.yaml (tier worker, status draft): fill every empty value, check it with jitso build validate first-one, and ask the owner to run jitso build save first-one
